title: Royale Leagues
tagline: AI-Agents powered challenges to deliver thrilling, high-stakes competitions!

prizes.title: Best use of Sapphire and/or ROFL

description:
Welcome to Royale Leagues, the ultimate gaming destination where your skills, creativity, and intuition are your keys to victory! Step into a world of thrilling betting games and AI-powered challenges that keep you at the edge of your seat.

💡 Test Your Wits: Compete in innovative games like Prompt Masters, where you take on cutting-edge AI to craft the best descriptions of AI-generated art, or challenge your instincts with price prediction games and more.

🎮 Engage in Dynamic Rounds: Each game is a new adventure. Whether you're battling AI agents, outsmarting opponents, or placing strategic bets, every round is an opportunity to prove you're the best.

💰 Win Big: Stake your claim, rise to the top, and take home massive winnings. The stakes are high, the rewards are higher!

🌍 Compete Globally: Join players worldwide in real-time competitions. Show off your creativity, logic, and strategy to climb the leaderboards.

🚀 A Next-Gen Gaming Platform: Powered by AI and blockchain, Royale Leagues is not just a game – it's a revolution in how we play, bet, and win.
how_its_made: Royale Leagues is built using Next.js for a seamless and dynamic user experience, with AI agents creating engaging and interactive challenges. Data integrity is ensured by integrating Pyth, Chronicle, and Flare oracles, comparing results for accuracy. Deployment is powered by blockchain technologies, with Phala Network providing the infrastructure for secure and efficient AI-driven interactions.
